player_prompt.intro:
Uyimdlali {player_id} kwiJalopi yaseGerman.
{phase_info}
Unikeli kadi {hand_size}.
Dlala kadi ngokuthi '[play N]', lapho N ingumhlalo wakho kwenza.
(Dlalani '[play 3]')
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: Akukho khadi linikezelwayo - isigaba sokudlala siqalile.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomathi yokunyakaza engekho mthethweni. Sebenzisa '[play N]' ukudlala ikhadi le-Nth esandleni sakho.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Kufuneka ulandele umzekelo wakhe uze udlale ikhadi elithi {lead_suit}.

trick.won_learning: Mdlali {winner_id} uphumelela kadi nezifunekile {card} kanti akhetha kadi entsha

phase.learning_complete: Umgangatho uphelile. Isigaba sokufunda sigqityiwe - onke amaqhinga aseleyo ayabala ukuze siphumelele.

draw.loser_received: You lost the trick and drew {card} from the deck.

trick_view.empty: Akukho khadi lidlalwe okwangoku eli qhinga.

board_str.player_line:
{observation}
Mdlali {player_id}: {scoring} kadi ezifunekile ({tricks} zonke), {hand_size} kadi ezikhethekile

outcome.summary: Learning phase - Player 0: {l0}, Player 1: {l1}. Playing phase - Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}. Player {winner_id} wins with {winner_tricks} scoring tricks!
